# ============================================================================
# ExamForge AI — Caddy Reverse Proxy Configuration (Hardened)
# ============================================================================
# Production-grade Caddy configuration with security headers, TLS,
# compression, and rate limiting.
#
# ROOT CAUSE: The original Caddyfile had no security headers, no rate
# limiting, no TLS configuration, and no security hardening.
# ============================================================================

# ─── Production Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────

examforge.ai, www.examforge.ai {
    # ─── TLS Configuration ───────────────────────────────────────────
    # Caddy auto-provisions Let's Encrypt certificates.
    # Additional hardening:
    tls {
        protocols tls1.2 tls1.3
        ciphers TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305 TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305
        curve x25519 secp256r1 secp384r1
    }

    # ─── Security Headers ────────────────────────────────────────────
    header {
        # Content Security Policy
        Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://examforge.ai https://*.supabase.co; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co wss://*.supabase.co https://api.flutterwave.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests"

        # HSTS — 2 years, include subdomains, preload
        Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload"

        # Prevent MIME sniffing
        X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"

        # Prevent clickjacking
        X-Frame-Options "DENY"

        # XSS Protection
        X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block"

        # Referrer policy
        Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

        # Permissions policy
        Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(self), usb=(), fullscreen=(self)"

        # Cross-origin policies
        Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy "same-origin"
        Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy "same-origin"

        # Cache control for API
        Cache-Control "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0"
        Pragma "no-cache"

        # Remove server identification
        -Server
    }

    # ─── Reverse Proxy to Flutter Web ────────────────────────────────
    reverse_proxy localhost:3000 {
        # Health check
        health_uri /health
        health_interval 30s
        health_timeout 5s

        # Timeouts
        transport http {
            read_timeout 300s
            write_timeout 300s
            dial_timeout 30s
        }
    }

    # ─── Rate Limiting ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    rate_limit {
        zone static_zone 10r/m
        zone api_zone 60r/m
        key {remote_host}
    }

    # ─── Compression ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    encode gzip zstd

    # ─── Logging ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    log {
        output file /var/log/caddy/examforge.log {
            roll_size 100mb
            roll_keep 30
            roll_keep_days 90
        }
        format json {
            time_format rfc3339
        }
        level INFO
    }

    # ─── Redirect www to non-www ─────────────────────────────────────
    redir https://examforge.ai{uri} permanent
}

# ─── API Subdomain ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

api.examforge.ai {
    tls {
        protocols tls1.2 tls1.3
    }

    header {
        Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload"
        X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
        X-Frame-Options "DENY"
        Referrer-Policy "no-referrer"
        -Server
    }

    # ─── Supabase Edge Functions ─────────────────────────────────────
    # Webhook endpoint
    handle /webhooks/flutterwave* {
        reverse_proxy localhost:54321/functions/v1/flutterwave-webhook
    }

    # Refund endpoint
    handle /api/refund* {
        reverse_proxy localhost:54321/functions/v1/process-refund
    }

    # Marketplace download
    handle /api/marketplace/download* {
        reverse_proxy localhost:54321/functions/v1/marketplace-download
    }

    # ─── Default API proxy ──────────────────────────────────────────
    handle {
        reverse_proxy localhost:54321 {
            health_uri /rest/v1/
            health_interval 30s
        }
    }

    # ─── Rate limiting for API ───────────────────────────────────────
    rate_limit {
        zone api_zone 120r/m
        key {remote_host}
    }

    # ─── Logging ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    log {
        output file /var/log/caddy/api.log {
            roll_size 100mb
            roll_keep 30
        }
        format json
        level INFO
    }
}

# ─── Admin Subdomain ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

admin.examforge.ai {
    tls {
        protocols tls1.2 tls1.3
    }

    header {
        Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload"
        X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
        X-Frame-Options "DENY"
        Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'"
        -Server
    }

    reverse_proxy localhost:3000 {
        header_up X-Admin-Portal "true"
    }

    rate_limit {
        zone admin_zone 30r/m
        key {remote_host}
    }

    log {
        output file /var/log/caddy/admin.log
        format json
    }
}

# ─── Staging Environment ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

staging.examforge.ai {
    tls {
        protocols tls1.2 tls1.3
    }

    header {
        Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains"
        X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
        X-Frame-Options "DENY"
        -Server
    }

    reverse_proxy localhost:3000

    log {
        output file /var/log/caddy/staging.log
        format json
    }
}
